packageRules.description: Placeholder images in illustrative code (ghcr.io/example/*, ghcr.io/acme/*) carry no real tags — never look them up.
tik and the kurly library ship calendar-versioned tags (YYYY.M.D), which the default docker versioning cannot order.

customManagers.description: Every workload's default image, pinned in its stage, its catalog annotation, and the generated catalog.json (and any README that names it) — matched together so the three stay in lockstep and the check-catalog gate stays green on the bump PR. A single generic manager covers every fully-qualified image rather than one manager per image; the placeholder registries are disabled in packageRules above.

The nginx image the examples and docs render with, so the illustrative manifests never pin a stale tag. Placeholder images (ghcr.io/acme/*, ghcr.io/example/*) carry no real tags and are deliberately not matched.
Alpine.js, fetched by gen-docs-data at docs-build time from the pinned version so the assembler page always ships the tracked release.
Operator versions the e2e scenarios install, pinned in hack/smoke/*.sh via a `# renovate:` comment above a `<TOOL>_VERSION="..."` line.
